ca_cert.description: Absolute path to the cluster's CA certificate used to verify the cluster's identity.

cert.description: Absolute path to this node's TLS certificate, signed by the cluster CA.

key.description: Absolute path to this node's TLS private key.

trusted_certs.description: Optional list of additional trusted CA certificate paths (colon-separated in rendered config).

listen_addr.description: IP address or hostname the daemon binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

listen_port.description: TCP port the daemon listens on. Standard port for pacemaker-remote is 3128.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for all communications. Disable only for testing or internal air-gapped networks.

pam_service.description: Name of the PAM service to use for authentication (only if auth='pam').

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging. Choose from: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency.

log_dest.description: Log destination: 'syslog' for system logging, or a file path (e.g., '/var/log/pacemaker-remote.log').

resources.description: List of remote resources managed by this daemon (e.g., systemd services or scripts).

name.description: Logical name of the remote resource (must be unique).

exec.description: Command or service unit to manage (e.g., '/usr/lib/ocf/resource.d/heartbeat/Stateful' or 'httpd.service').

user.description: OS user to run the resource as (optional).

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before forcing shutdown during stop operation.
